# pbs_verify_job (Resource)

Manages a PBS backup verification job.

Verification jobs check backup integrity by validating checksums and ensuring all data chunks 
are readable. This helps detect corruption or storage issues before you need to restore. 
The `ignore_verified` option skips recently verified backups, and `outdated_after` 
determines how many days until a backup is considered due for re-verification.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the verification job.
- `schedule` (String) When to run the verification job. Uses systemd calendar event format (e.g., `weekly`, `Mon 03:00`).
- `store` (String) The datastore name where backups will be verified.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) A comment describing this verification job.
- `ignore_verified` (Boolean) Skip backups that have been recently verified. Defaults to `false`.
- `max_depth` (Number) Maximum recursion depth when traversing namespace hierarchy.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace to verify. Optional, supports pattern matching (e.g., `ns1`, `ns1/sub`).
- `outdated_after` (Number) Number of days after which a backup is considered outdated and needs re-verification. Only applies when `ignore_verified` is `true`.

### Read-Only

- `digest` (String) SHA-256 digest of the PBS configuration file (verify.cfg) as of the last read. Informational only: it covers all objects in that file, changes on every write and is not used for locking.
